name: Heartbeat and last reboot
description: Latest heartbeat per selected computer; delayed after 20 minutes.
kql:
Heartbeat
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| join kind=leftouter (
    Event
    | where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
    | where EventID == 12 and Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-General"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
    | project Computer, LastReboot = todatetime(parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.EventData.Data[6]["#text"])
) on Computer
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, ComputerPrivateIPs,
    LastHeartbeat = now() - TimeGenerated,
    Status = iff(TimeGenerated < ago(20m), "Error", "OK"),
    TimeSinceLastReboot = now() - LastReboot
| order by Computer asc
